Container.Name: kb-service
Container.Overview: The one door to the shared knowledge library. STARTED IN ORDER: kb-postgres, then kb-redis, then kb-litellm, then kb-service, then kb-webui. There is no template equivalent of compose depends_on, so nothing enforces that for you. NETWORK: the kb containers share one user-defined Docker network named kb that you create once, by hand, before the first start (a template cannot create a network, so Network stays bridge here - set it to kb when you create the container). Docker must preserve user-defined networks across updates (Unraid: Settings > Docker, Preserve user defined networks = Yes), or the containers fall back to bridge and the container names stop resolving. EXPOSURE: this container is exposed on your LAN through the host port you choose, behind bearer tokens; anything further (a domain, reverse proxy, TLS) is a separate step for whoever administers your network. RELEASE: v0.1.0 is the Stage 0 skeleton - it answers health and whoami only, and it ignores the database and embedding settings until a later release. Those variables are carried now because adding them later would need a template sync. REQUIRED: the service refuses to start (exit code 2) without KB_PERSONA_TOKENS, a JSON object of caller name to token with every token at least 32 characters. STORAGE: /assets holds original files and /export the plain-file export; put both on a pool and /assets under backup. The process runs as user 99:100. IMAGE TAG: pinned to one release; an Update is a deliberate bump of that pin.
Container.Description: Knowledge service for the shared library. Start after kb-litellm, before kb-webui. LAN-exposed; set a free host port, the caller tokens and the database URL.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Host port for the service (REST at /, MCP at /mcp, health at /health); the container always listens on 8000 internally - change the host side only. No default is offered: pick a free port.

Config.Name: Assets
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Original files and derived images; losing this loses the originals. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kb-service/assets. Put it under backup.

Config.Name: Export
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The nightly plain-file export of the library. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kb-service/export.

Config.Name: KB_PERSONA_TOKENS
Config.Description: REQUIRED. JSON object of caller name to bearer token, format {"<caller>":"<token>"}. Every token is at least 32 characters, no two callers share one, and the object is not empty; otherwise the service exits 2 at start. Use long random values.

Config.Name: KB_DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: REQUIRED. PostgreSQL connection URL, format postgresql://<user>:<password>@kb-postgres:5432/<db> - the user, password and database set on kb-postgres, the host being its container name on the kb network. Percent-encode any reserved character in the password. Ignored by v0.1.0.

Config.Name: KB_STACK
Config.Description: Which library this service fronts. Only global is accepted; any other value makes the service exit 2 at start. Leave global.

Config.Name: KB_EMBED_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Embedding endpoint: the kb-litellm route on the kb network, which serves the embed model. Blank: embedding is off and search is by keyword only. Ignored by v0.1.0.

Config.Name: KB_EMBED_MODEL
Config.Description: Embedding model name as kb-litellm lists it: the alias, not the model file. Leave embed unless config.yaml names it differently. Ignored by v0.1.0.

Config.Name: KB_EMBED_API_KEY
Config.Description: Key for the embedding endpoint above. Blank if the endpoint takes none. Ignored by v0.1.0.

Config.Name: LITELLM_URL
Config.Description: Base URL of the model router: the kb-litellm container on the kb network. Leave the default. Ignored by v0.1.0.

Config.Name: LITELLM_KEY
Config.Description: Key for kb-litellm: its master key, or a virtual key it issued. Blank: the router refuses calls. Ignored by v0.1.0.

Config.Name: KB_EXPORT_DIR
Config.Description: Container path the export is written to. Leave /export: it is the mount above. Ignored by v0.1.0.

Config.Name: KB_ASSETS_DIR
Config.Description: Container path original files and derived images are stored under. Leave /assets: it is the mount above. Ignored by v0.1.0.
